title: 第17章 苏环的光速微操第18章 亚洲区王者‘雷霆万钧’
content_zh:
第十七章 苏环的光速微操
“快跑！”后方王清雅看到瑞雯陷入险境，不由情不自禁，脱口而出。
话一出口，王清雅就捂住嘴巴，脸色微红。
她自己都不知道自己是怎么说出这两个字的。
她却是不知道，她已经被苏环的瑞雯给带入了节奏当中，已经深深被这场精彩战斗而吸引。
这，就是英雄联盟的魅力所在，这，也是电竞游戏之所以可以成功的所在。
它能够深深的牵动人心，让其为胜利喜悦，为失败而失落。
然而最能让人心生愉悦狂喜的是逆风翻盘，以少胜多。
这就是电竞游戏的最能让人疯狂迷恋上的原因。
而英雄联盟就是这样一款可以让人笑、让人喜、让人怒、让人怨……的游戏。
这一声‘快跑’苏环也是听到了，毕竟有些大声。
不过这个时候，他可不敢分神。
就在盲僧猛扑到自己身边，接下来就要一个大招‘猛龙摆尾’踢向琴女方向的时候。
苏环看到其屏幕内，盲僧使用出大招‘猛龙摆尾’的动作画面时，当那一脚就要踢到瑞雯的身上的时候。
“就是现在！！”苏环瞳孔一缩，精神异常集中，整个人都绷紧了。
一个闪现往对面伊泽瑞尔突进，但是距离还是不够，随后瞬间接上‘勇往直前’再突进一段距离。
而在苏环使用出‘勇往直前’的同一时间，大招‘放逐之锋’闪电开启，取消了瑞雯那极其缓慢的大招前摇状态。
但是，距离伊泽瑞尔还是不够近，而就在这时，盲僧的一脚几乎在苏环闪现的同一时间狠狠的踢了上去。
那么这一踢，是否有效？
系统判定有效。

当看着瑞雯又被狠狠带了一段距离之后，苏环心中松了一口气，随后眼中杀戮爆发。
那么，来吧。
即使剑是断的，整个场面我也能Hold住！！
这一脚，直接就把瑞雯踢到了伊泽瑞尔的身边。
……………
“卧槽卧槽卧槽！！”还在中路推线的发条，一见到这操作，直接目瞪口呆。
在他眼中，由于视觉问题，他所看到的是。
盲僧一个大招‘猛龙摆尾’击出之后，随后瑞雯大神直接在半空中一个闪现，之后一个‘勇往直前’再开启大招‘放逐之锋’，一下子直接被踢到紫色方伊泽瑞尔的身边。
一个瞬间，三个动作。
这手速简直爆表了，有木有！！
然而他不知道的是，被盲僧的大招‘猛龙摆尾’踢到半空中，是不能做任何动作的。
而之所以能在空中完成这三个动作，只是在被盲僧踢到之前所做出来的操作而已，所以就造成了一种视觉错乱的效果。
发条没有看清，但是在后方的王清雅却是由于精神十分注意集中，仅次与苏环，所以她看得清清楚楚。
“神…神操作！！”当真真正正的神操作出现在王清雅面前的时候，她激动异常，毕竟是亲眼所见，清清楚楚的展示在她面前。
而瑞雯做完那三个动作确实极其飞速，堪称光速。
要知道瑞雯是在盲僧一脚快要踢到其身上的时候，直接瞬间用出闪现、勇往直前、放逐之锋三个技能。
而要是在用出这些技能之前，被盲僧踢到的话，那么瞬间就有可能被打断。
毕竟被盲僧踢到之后，是不能使用任何技能的。
“清雅姐，清雅姐。”这时候旁边的李青青对着王清雅叫道。
“怎么了？”眼神尚处于震惊当中，王清雅下意识道。

“我刚刚好像看到这个人的手指好像出现幻影，只不过是一瞬间，一下就消失了。你说这会不会是错觉。”李青青心中有点怕怕的说道。
“什么？幻影？”王清雅再一次震撼，她感觉这一天所受到的冲击比她出生到昨天都要多得多，但是她没有怀疑。
盲僧的那一脚‘猛龙摆尾’，加上动作画面，估计都不足一秒。
而瑞雯还是在那一脚快要达到其身上的时候才使出闪现、‘勇往直前’和大招‘放逐之锋’。
也就是说留给瑞雯操作的时间不足0。5秒。
0。5秒能干吗？王清雅不知道，但是现在她知道了。
这一刻，王清雅下定决心，无论如何都要邀请对方加入电竞社。
她知道，眼前之人，未来的电竞之路估计不一般，不可能局限与一所小小的大学。
但是再过一个月全国高校联赛就要开启了，只要有眼前之人的加入，或许科技大学能触碰一下那遥不可及的冠军之位。
而最主要的是，在这个日渐由英雄联盟主导的世界，眼前之人，到底能走到哪一步？
她很想看清。
苏环心中非常激动，他知道他的操作突破了。
他没想到一把普普通通的低端排位赛，能让他的操作有所突破。
那一瞬间，他虽然看不到，但是他知道估计的手指会出现一种幻影的视线错觉。
而在苏环前世，这是他梦寐以求，没有达到的一种极端情况下的光速微操。
在前世视频中，他也没有见过这种光速操作。
这是他心中幻想出来的操作，这一刻他达到了，而且是在那么极限的状况下实现。
手速的突破，使得他左手有些颤抖，但是没关系，这并不阻碍他接下来的操作。
他微微翘起的嘴角，克制不住张大，无声的大笑着。
没想到，没想到竟然真的达到了光速微操的境界。

随后看着就在自己身旁的没有任何反应伊泽瑞尔，眼中杀戮之气掠过。
那么，小黄毛，准备好了吗？
一记普攻加‘震魂怒吼’的晕眩和红BUFF效果黏住了伊泽瑞尔。
随后一段‘折翼之舞’毫不犹豫的迅速甩出，触发被动普攻击出，同一时间二段‘折翼之舞’接上普攻。
最后激活第三段‘折翼之舞’狠狠下落，就要击飞伊泽瑞尔的瞬间，大招‘疾风斩’瞬间甩出，而第三段‘折翼之舞’紧接其下。
一瞬间，在伊泽瑞尔还没有反应过来，连E技能‘奥术跃迁’都还没有使用出来的时候，就被秒了。
“。。。。。。”这是在伊泽瑞尔死后，他打在屏幕上的信息。
他不知道刚刚发生了什么事情，距离自己那么远的瑞雯一瞬间就扑倒自己旁边，把自己秒了。
他还没有反应过来。
“怎么回事！？”琴女看着眨眼间被秒的伊泽，瞬间傻眼。手中的大招‘狂舞终乐章’下意识的放出。
瑞雯被晕眩住了。
但是现在已经没有用了，这一刻伊泽被秒，而豹女则是离得太远了。
是的，刚刚那一段操作，直接脱离了豹女‘标枪投掷’的范围，达到了两发‘标枪投掷’的距离叠加才能命中的范围。
现在想要标中瑞雯的话，不可能。
至于盲僧想要接近，却是有可能。
一个闪现，加上插眼W，倒是可以接近瑞雯。
但是现在这样做已经没有用了，伊泽瑞尔已死，豹女的‘标枪投掷’又难以命中。
这样做的话，就是再送一个人头而已，而且这一刻，紫色方正处于尚未反应过来的震撼当中。
content_en:
Chapter 17 Su Huan’s light speed micro-control
"Run!" Wang Qingya blurted out from behind when she saw Ruiwen in danger.
As soon as the words came out, Wang Qingya covered her mouth and turned slightly red.
She didn't even know how she said these two words.
But she didn't know that she had been brought into the rhythm by Su Huan's Ruiwen, and she had been deeply attracted by this exciting battle.
This is the charm of League of Legends, and this is why e-sports games can be successful.
It can deeply affect people's hearts, making them feel joyful about victory and disappointed about failure.
However, the most joyful and ecstatic thing is to come back against the wind and win with less.
This is the reason why people are most crazy about e-sports games.
League of Legends is such a game that can make people laugh, make people happy, make people angry, make people complain...
Su Huan also heard the sound of "Run!", it was a bit loud after all.
But at this time, he didn't dare to be distracted.
Just when the blind monk rushed to his side, he was about to use his ultimate move "Raptor's Tail Swing" to kick Qin Nu in the direction.
Su Huan saw on the screen the action scene of the blind monk using his ultimate move, 'Raptor's Tail Swing', when that kick was about to hit Riwen.
"That's it now!!" Su Huan's pupils shrank, his energy was extremely concentrated, and his whole body was tense.
He flashed forward and rushed towards Ezreal on the opposite side, but the distance was still not enough. Then he instantly connected with 'Forward Bravely' and rushed forward some distance.
At the same time that Su Huan used 'Forward Bravely', the ultimate move 'Blade of Exile' was activated with lightning, canceling the extremely slow forward swing state of Riven's ultimate move.
However, the distance to Ezreal was still not close enough, and at this moment, the blind monk kicked Su Huan hard at almost the same time that he flashed.
So is this kick effective?
The system determines it is valid.
Su Huan breathed a sigh of relief when he saw Ruiwen being taken away for a long distance, and then the killing exploded in his eyes.
So, come on.
Even if the sword is broken, I can hold the whole scene! !
This kick directly kicked Raven to Ezreal's side.
……………
"Holy shit, shit, shit!!" Clockwork, who was still pushing the line in the middle, was stunned when he saw this operation.
In his eyes, due to vision problems, what he saw was.
After the blind monk used his ultimate move 'Dragon Tail Swing', the great god Riven then flashed directly in mid-air, and then 'Forward Bravely' and then activated the ultimate move 'Exile's Edge', and was kicked directly to the side of purple Fang Ezreal.
One moment, three actions.
This hand speed is simply off the charts, is it true? !
However, what he didn't know was that he couldn't make any moves after being kicked into the air by the blind monk's ultimate move, 'Dragon Tail Swing'.
The reason why these three actions can be completed in the air is just the operations performed before being kicked by the blind monk, so it creates a visual confusion effect.
Clockwork couldn't see clearly, but Wang Qingya who was behind was very focused, second only to Su Huan, so she could see clearly.
"God... God operation!!" When the real God operation appeared in front of Wang Qingya, she was extremely excited. After all, she saw it with her own eyes and it was clearly displayed in front of her.
And Ruiwen completed those three movements very quickly, almost at the speed of light.
You must know that Riven used the three skills of Blink, Forward Courage, and Exile's Edge immediately when the blind monk was about to kick him.
And if you are kicked by the blind monk before using these skills, you may be interrupted in an instant.
After all, after being kicked by the blind monk, you can't use any skills.
"Sister Qingya, sister Qingya." At this time, Li Qingqing next to her called to Wang Qingya.
"What's wrong?" His eyes were still in shock., Wang Qingya said subconsciously.
"I just seemed to see a phantom appear on this person's fingers, but it just disappeared for a moment. Do you think this is an illusion?" Li Qingqing said with a little fear in his heart.
"What? Phantom?" Wang Qingya was shocked again. She felt that she had received much more shocks on this day than she had received since she was born until yesterday, but she had no doubts.
The blind monk's 'raptor tail swing' kick, together with the action scene, probably lasted less than one second.
But when the kick was about to reach her, Riven used flash, 'Go Forward' and her ultimate move 'Exile's Edge'.
In other words, the time left for Ruiwen to operate is less than 0.5 seconds.
Can it be done in 0.5 seconds? Wang Qingya didn't know, but now she knows.
At this moment, Wang Qingya made up her mind to invite the other party to join the e-sports club no matter what.
She knew that the future of e-sports for the person in front of her was probably not ordinary, and could not be limited to a small university.
But the National College League will start in one month. As long as the people in front of us join in, maybe the University of Science and Technology can touch the elusive championship position.
And the most important thing is, in this world increasingly dominated by the League of Legends, how far can the person in front of me go?
She wanted to see clearly.
Su Huan was very excited, knowing that his operation had achieved a breakthrough.
He didn't expect that an ordinary low-end qualifying game could make a breakthrough in his operation.
At that moment, although he couldn't see it, he knew that there would be a phantom sight illusion on his fingers.
In Su Huan's previous life, this was an extreme micro-control of light speed that he had dreamed of but could not achieve.
He had never seen this kind of light speed operation in the videos of his previous life.
This was the operation he imagined in his mind. At this moment, he achieved it, and he did it under such extreme conditions.
The breakthrough in hand speed made his left hand tremble a little, but it didn't matter, it didn't hinder his subsequent operations.
The corners of his slightly raised mouth couldn't help opening up, laughing silently.
Unexpectedly, I didn't expect that I actually reached the realm of micro-manipulation at the speed of light.
Then he looked at the unresponsive Ezreal next to him, and a murderous aura passed through his eyes.
So, little yellow hair, are you ready?
A basic attack plus the stun and red BUFF effect of 'Soul-shaking Roar' stuck to Ezreal.
Then a "Dance of Broken Wings" was quickly thrown out without hesitation, triggering a passive basic attack. At the same time, the second "Dance of Broken Wings" followed the basic attack.
Finally, the third section of the 'Dance of Broken Wings' was activated and fell hard, just when Ezreal was about to be knocked away. The ultimate move 'Wind Slash' was thrown out instantly, and the third section of 'Dance of Broken Wings' followed immediately.
In an instant, before Ezreal could react or even use his E skill 'Arcane Leap', he was killed.
"..." This was the message he typed on the screen after Ezreal died.
He didn't know what had just happened. Ruiwen, who was so far away from him, threw herself next to him in an instant, killing him for a second.
He hasn't reacted yet.
"What's going on!?" Qin Nu looked at Ize who was killed in the blink of an eye, and was instantly dumbfounded. The ultimate move in his hand, "Dancing Finale", was released subconsciously.
Raven was stunned.
But it was of no use now. At this moment, Izawa was defeated and Leopard Girl was too far away.
Yes, the operation just now was directly out of the range of Leopard Girl's "javelin throw", and reached the range where the distance of two "javelin throws" can be combined to hit.
It is impossible to win the bid for Ruiwen now.
As for the blind monk wanting to get close, it is possible.
With a flash and a ward W, he can get close to Raven.
But it's useless to do so now, Ezreal is dead, and the Leopard Girl's 'javelin throw' is difficult to hit.If you do this, you will just give away another head, and at this moment, the purple founder is in a state of shock that he has not yet reacted to.
